sources.scope: The page explicitly discusses a 2023–2024 grant; its table lists NYSED codes, degree labels, HEGIS codes and 'Perkins Funded' values. It is NOT proof of 2026–27 Perkins funding or student eligibility.
Current department page separately maps all four codes to named nursing paths and describes NEX; it does not establish state registry institution headers.

limitations: QCC's 2023–24 Perkins table is historical and cannot establish current-year funding, program admission or individual student grant eligibility.
QCC's nursing department and Perkins office are two first-party QCC sources, not two independent state registration records. Three NYSED detail-page bodies still lack visible institution headers.
HEGIS 5208.1 and 5208.10 are printed school classification labels, not CIP2020 51.3801, and cannot be used as a direct CIP equivalence or professional licensure crosswalk.
School-described AAS/BS dual/joint pathways do not guarantee a BS award or professional license.
Preserve the exact source typo 'Nuring' in evidence transcription only; never expose it as the canonical program name.
